resources.string: Allow Sukut notifications in Android settings to enter the pairing code while its dialog is open.
Activate Sukut

1. Connect to Wi-Fi and enable Developer options → Wireless debugging.

2. Tap Pair Sukut below, then choose Pair device with pairing code in Android settings. Keep that dialog open.

3. Pull down notifications. On Sukut’s notification, tap Enter pairing code and send the six digits. Return to Sukut after pairing.

Next time, enable Wireless debugging and tap Activate. No computer or Shizuku app is needed.
Phone-only pairing requires Android 11 or newer. On Android 10, use Sukut on Windows → Phone → Activate Sukut.

Activation connects only to this phone. Pairing is saved in Android Keystore. After activation, discovery and the debugging connection close; audio stays on your phone. You can turn Wireless debugging off. Activate again after restarting your phone or updating Sukut.
Windows → Phone → Activate Sukut remains available if your phone blocks local Wireless debugging. Pairing is an Android permission step; Sukut cannot silently enable it.

Delay and picture sync
Audio delay is the time between something happening and hearing it — for example, a game tap and its sound.
Desync means sound and picture do not line up: lips may move before you hear the voice. More buffering, Bluetooth and phone effects can add delay.
For videos and games, try Lowest if sound stays smooth. Increase buffering if you hear crackles or short pauses. Sukut cannot automatically correct every app’s video timing.
